explication: Swift is a programming language implementation: developers write Swift programs, which the compiler analyzes and optimizes; the standard library and platform runtimes provide the facilities those programs use. The tree and excerpts support compiler AST, storage type-checking, diagnostics, SIL optimization, standard-library string storage, and runtime/overlay subsystems. Several major capabilities are documented or visible in the tree but their implementation and wiring were not sampled, so those branches are shown without speculative call relationships.
